I request continuance of my dental plan coverage during the time I will be temporarily off pay status.  I agree to make direct payment of the total premium to my dental plan carrier.  I understand that failure to make timely premium payments and/or failure to notify the carrier of loss of eligibility during my leave status will result in termination of my coverage and the carrier's liability while off pay status. I understand that I will not be billed by the carrier and that I must pay the premium for the month in which I return to pay status.

I agree to pay :
